name: XTR press-fit bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 58 g for the exact SM-BB94-41A HOLLOWTECH II bottom-bracket assembly. Threaded and press-fit model identities remain separate; the weighed shell configuration is not further specified.
